subject: current-affairs
title: World Organizations & Their Headquarters
description: Complete list of major international organizations with headquarters

content.overview: International organizations play crucial roles in global governance, development, and cooperation. Headquarters are frequently asked in exams.
keyPoints: UN (United Nations): New York, USA — 1945, 193 members
UNICEF: New York, USA — children's welfare
IAEA (International Atomic Energy Agency): Vienna, Austria
IMF (International Monetary Fund): Washington DC, USA
FAO (Food and Agriculture Organization): Rome, Italy
ICC (International Criminal Court): The Hague, Netherlands
ICJ (International Court of Justice): The Hague, Netherlands
AIIB (Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank): Beijing, China

mnemonics.explanation: Geneva (Switzerland): WHO, WTO, ILO, ICRC (Red Cross)
Washington DC (USA): IMF and World Bank — the two Bretton Woods institutions
New York (USA): United Nations HQ and UNICEF
The Hague (Netherlands): International Court of Justice and International Criminal Court

mnemonics.trick: ADB-Manila, AIIB-Beijing, SCO-Beijing, ASEAN-Jakarta, SAARC-Kathmandu, BIMSTEC-Dhaka, NDB(BRICS)-Shanghai
mnemonics.explanation: Asian HQs: ADB (Manila), AIIB & SCO (Beijing), ASEAN (Jakarta), SAARC (Kathmandu), BIMSTEC (Dhaka), BRICS NDB (Shanghai)

quiz.question: Where is the headquarters of UNESCO?
quiz.explanation: UNESCO headquarters is in Paris, France

quiz.question: FAO headquarters is in:
quiz.explanation: FAO (Food and Agriculture Organization) is headquartered in Rome, Italy

quiz.question: SAARC headquarters is in:
quiz.explanation: SAARC headquarters is in Kathmandu, Nepal

quiz.question: ADB (Asian Development Bank) is headquartered in:
quiz.explanation: ADB is headquartered in Manila, Philippines (AIIB is in Beijing)

quiz.question: African Union headquarters is in:
quiz.explanation: African Union is headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (Arab League is in Cairo)

quiz.question: Which two organizations are headquartered in Vienna?
quiz.explanation: IAEA and OPEC are both headquartered in Vienna, Austria
